deep_write_coverage.claim_allowed: Some entries are deep hand-written/source-backed coverage; P4 provides title-index bridge coverage.
deep_write_coverage.claim_not_allowed: Full deep-lore restoration or full article-level paraphrase coverage.
deep_write_coverage.expanded_bridge_claim_allowed: Expanded P4 bridge entries are denser original RP prompts built from page-title taxonomy and manifest metadata.
deep_write_coverage.expanded_bridge_claim_not_allowed: They are not raw article paraphrases and do not increase the deep source-backed title count.
deep_write_coverage.p4_article_reviewed_claim_allowed: A small high-impact P4 subset has raw-page review evidence and original route-ready paraphrase seeds.
deep_write_coverage.p4_article_reviewed_claim_not_allowed: This is not full P4 article-level restoration and does not make the whole plot fully restored.

why_full_restoration_cannot_be_claimed: The allpages manifest stores metadata only and does not store raw article text.
The P4 bridge layer has 1882 entries; 1882 are expanded bridge prompts, but they are still title-taxonomy/metadata based rather than article-level paraphrases.
The main static worldbook is not source-certified according to docs/worldbook-source-status.md.
123 quote-marker-heavy static entries still need manual copyright/style review according to docs/worldbook-source-status.md.
Full deep-lore completion still requires replacing bridge entries with richer original RP-ready paraphrase where title-taxonomy prompts are insufficient.
The frontend currently defines 15 scenes, so it is not a full playable restoration of the 2142-title source index.
Only a small P4 subset has article-review evidence; the remaining P4 bridge layer still needs article-level review before full deep-lore restoration can be claimed.
maintenance_rule: When a P4 bridge entry is expanded into deeper source-backed prose, keep extensions.source_refs, rerun source audits, and update this document pair with the new deep-written and bridge counts.

v1_0_17_acceptance.item: Title-index coverage is auditable at 2142/2142 manifest titles.
Source/bridge entries are auditable through source refs at 2089/2089 entries.
Release wording may claim full manifest-title coverage but must not imply every P4 entry is a deep hand-written article paraphrase.
Frontend scene coverage is documented as 15 scenes across 3 routes.
Full deep-lore restoration, full article-level paraphrase, or full frontend story implementation.
